A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ControlFace study and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Relocated figures and renumbered citations can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original ControlFace evaluations, a user study, component ablations, and qualitative generalization results, including supplementary experiments in Appendix C.

after.justification: v4 retains those empirical results and adds CMM architecture comparisons in Table 10 and an additional guidance comparison in Figure 8.

M1.justification: Section 4.5 revises the stated training formulation to encode both reference and target images and use the noisy target latent z_T,t in Equation 5, replacing z_R,t. The architecture and RCG procedure remain unchanged. This is a documented objective correction; the PDFs do not establish an implementation change.

E1.justification: Both versions use CelebV-HQ training data, FFHQ evaluation, and out-of-domain stylized faces. Pose, shape, expression, and lighting coverage is retained. The added ablations introduce no new dataset, population, or task scenario.

E2.justification: Figure 8 adds CFG†, which applies null conditioning to CMM, to the guidance comparison. Table 10 adds three CMM variant comparators. The main GIF, CapHuman, Arc2Face, and DiffusionRig comparisons remain unchanged.

E3.justification: New experimental controls include a ResNet-based CMM, reference-only CMM, a reference-side Face Controller without CMM, and null conditioning at CMM during the guidance sweep. Existing evaluation metrics, guidance-scale range, and primary training and inference settings are retained.

E4.justification: Appendix C.3 and new Table 10 extend the existing CMM input ablation to architecture and reference-conditioning choices. Figure 8 additionally tests sensitivity to guidance scale for CFG†. Earlier component, video-training, CLIP-only, and out-of-domain analyses remain present.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. The new results follow the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 10 adds re-inference error/ID results of 5.27/0.7199, 5.40/0.7184, and 5.03/0.7290 for the three alternative designs; ControlFace repeats its existing 4.85/0.7586 values. Figure 8 adds a nonmonotonic CFG† curve. Numerical results in Tables 1–9 are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 5 changes the denoised variable from the reference latent to the target latent, a non-equivalent correction to the mathematical training specification. Other equations remain unchanged. The correction is incomplete because adjacent prose still describes perturbing z_R and defines z_R,t.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning facial control without individual fine-tuning, identity and detail preservation, paired-video training, CMM, and RCG. Added ablations support existing claims without expanding their scope.

C2.justification: Explanations of reconstruction-training failure, identity/control tradeoffs, and RCG grounding are retained. Limitations concerning DECA accuracy and training on one video dataset are unchanged. The added passages report comparative findings without introducing a substantive new mechanism explanation or applicability boundary.

D1.justification: Appendix A retains the same hardware, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, training budget, sampling settings, and component parameter counts. Project-access information is unchanged. New ablations provide high-level variant definitions but no further implementation specifications.

R1.justification: v4 adds InstaDrag as reference 41 and cites it alongside prior augmented self-attention approaches in Section 4.3. The remaining works match after renumbering, and the broader related-work discussion and novelty positioning are retained.

P1.justification: Edits are localized to the training formulation, guidance discussion, an expanded and renamed Appendix C.3, and an author-name correction from Gunho to Geonho. The main narrative and section organization remain largely unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 8 is redrawn with colored curves, a revised legend, and the added CFG† comparison. Table 10 is new, Figure 3 gains the Aug-Attn* label correction, and several appendix figures move. Existing qualitative image content is retained.

improvement.justification: The added guidance comparator and CMM architecture ablations provide useful, targeted evidence for the existing design choices, while Equation 5 moves toward the stated paired-training objective. The gains are limited: primary results and coverage are unchanged, new variants receive little implementation detail, the loss explanation remains inconsistent, and Appendix C.3 incorrectly references Figure 10 instead of Table 10.
